name: Donchian breakout and retest
idea: After a close beyond the Donchian channel (the Donchian breakout's own settings), wait for the market to come back to the broken edge and hold it; the idea has ended when the close is back through that level.

params.label: Channel bars
params.help: How many bars before the break make the channel.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the channel the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: Retest within (bars)
params.help: The return to the broken edge must come within this many bars after the breakout; a later return is a new base, not a retest.

params.label: Wait for a reversal at the level
params.help: On: the retest must show a reversal at the broken edge. Off: a touch of the edge with the close held beyond it is enough.

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: Where the retest idea is wrong: beyond the pullback to the edge, beyond the breakout's own reference, or beyond whichever of the two is farther.
choice_labels: Whichever of the two is farther

params.label: The breakout's own reference
params.help: Just beyond the broken edge, the channel's far side, or its middle.
choice_labels: The far side of the channel

params.label: Edge buffer
params.help: For 'just beyond the broken edge': how many average true ranges beyond it.

lower_of_both.long: Least(RetestEntryRef("retest_low", "up", "donchian", $retest_max_bars, $retest_reversal, k=$k, n=$n), RetestEntryRef($breakout_ref, "up", "donchian", $retest_max_bars, $retest_reversal, $stop_mult, k=$k, n=$n))
lower_of_both.short: Greatest(RetestEntryRef("retest_low", "down", "donchian", $retest_max_bars, $retest_reversal, k=$k, n=$n), RetestEntryRef($breakout_ref, "down", "donchian", $retest_max_bars, $retest_reversal, $stop_mult, k=$k, n=$n))
